mission: Attack the next two RSI frontiers: applicability around a real ambiguous external Finance Effect and presentation-order stability after dependency-complete synthesis.
questionOrHypothesis: P10: does planning-time applicability basis remain useful across the full Effect lifecycle, or should authority hand off to exact admitted identity? P11: does identity-preserving deterministic presentation improve semantics after complete evidence coverage?
evidenceSelection: Current Finance C2 v3 owner executor/ledger with fake counted OKX transport only; no live financial write. P11 reuses the exact frozen six-dataset Finance evidence from P9 and a separate ordered Effect-event negative control.
strongBaseline: P10 changed-only, raw-current, always-on scoped basis, and phase-gated basis; physical owner consequence matrix. P11 raw permutations, stable dataset-order list, identity map, plus owner-ordering negative control.
negativeControl: P10 new material pre-admission drift must create no write; post-dispatch FORM_NEW_EFFECT is physically allowed to produce another POST and therefore exposes identity-scope risk. P11 naive lexical sorting of explicitly ordered Effect events must fail semantic reconstruction.
candidate: P10 phase-gated applicability-to-identity handoff. P11 no promoted normalization candidate unless unambiguous semantic trials outperform raw order.
independentOracle: Finance production owner code and exact tests define Effect replay/dispatch consequences. P11 frozen mechanical oracle is clarified before final v3 to remove ambiguous tracking-error semantics.
invalidityConditions: Count P10a/P10b final strict scores after detecting their too-narrow post-dispatch oracle.
Count P11-v1 three surviving semantic outputs after 141 wire failures.
Use P11-v2 to prove ordering after detecting target ambiguity.
Treat a new Effect identity as protected by the old Effect exactly-once guarantee.
Treat lexical sort as safe on order-semantic evidence.
authorityBoundary: Finance owns Effect identity/admission/dispatch/reconciliation and all financial consequences. Computing only observes frozen local owner semantics and fake transport counters. P11 representation experiments create no owner authority.

budget.note: Invalidated P10/P11 diagnostic campaigns consumed additional compute and remain apparatus history; budget is capacity, not evidence obligation.

stopRule: Stop after owner phase consequence matrix, corrected owner-grounded P10 campaign, unambiguous P11 final campaign, ordered-event negative control, explicit invalidation of failed evaluators/wire schemas, and contraction proof.
deletionOrNoChangeOutcome: Expected long-lived outcome is research-law revision only. No new service/CLI/compiler is promoted unless the final unambiguous campaign earns it.
publicationBoundary: Do not publish a global effect-phase service, economic-intent deduper, EvidenceNormalizer, OrderService, or generic ContextCompiler.
